text: The external organs are tenfold: five are the cognitive senses and five are the organs of action. These ten constitute the external instruments. Among these, that which is known as the object of the internal instrument is the object of experience for the intellect, the ego, and the mind. In the present moment, the ear hears only the present sound, not the past nor the future. Similarly, the eye sees only the present form, not the past nor the future. The skin perceives the present touch, the tongue the present taste, and the nose the present smell, not the past nor the future.
